Scene 2 | 33-67% | motif right, centre 52%/42% of its box, close-up at scale 1.9, rotated 0deg, field inverted (#F1ECE4 ground, #11100F text) | film.mp4 scrubs 4s -> 8s across 33-67%, inner media scales 1.9 -> 1 back to whole frame at 60-74%, field swaps #F1ECE4 -> #11100F at 66-68% | in 34-40, hold 40-60, out 60-66

MOTION: p = clamp(-track.getBoundingClientRect().top / (track.offsetHeight - stage.offsetHeight), 0, 1). One track, one position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh stage, no ancestor with overflow hidden.
Smooth with drawn += (p - drawn) * (1 - exp(-dt / 120ms)); set drawn = p on load, resize and anchor jump. Every value is a pure function of drawn, so scrolling back reverses it.
Animate only transform, opacity and clip-path, eased cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) inside each range. Never prevent or replace native scroll.
Scene 1 is complete at 0% and the last scene at 100%. Outgoing text is at opacity 0 before incoming text appears. The motif stays visible through every hand-over.
Video (M2): muted, playsinline, preload="metadata", poster="poster.jpg", a keyframe at least every 10 frames; drive video.currentTime = drawn * duration, seeking only after the last seek finishes; show poster.jpg on error.
LOOK: Ground #11100F, text #F1ECE4, accent #D6A45C (accent for shapes only, never text); inverted field swaps to ground #F1ECE4 and text #11100F; display Cormorant Garamond, serif; body Manrope, sans-serif. Display clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 144px). The main line of every scene, also a category or subject line, is display type: scale down cleanly inside 40% desktop columns or mobile frames so the longest word fits inside its container with at least 24px margin and zero right-edge clipping, and never under 36px. Body at least 16px, measure at most 60ch. Keep the stage and inverted background layer strictly behind both motif and text (background z-index 0, single motif layer z-index 1, text layer z-index 2); drive opacity on only ONE wrapper per scene so inner .copy/.mask elements stay at opacity 1 (never leaving Scene 1 hidden at p = 0); at p = 0 the stage starts in Scene 1's opening ground (never inverted at rest), and when a later scene inverts, drive ground, text and motif colours together through inherited root/stage CSS variables at every breakpoint (>= 4.5:1 contrast; never use filter invert alone and never hardcode dark text under mobile media queries). LAYOUT: The motif lives in one persistent stage-bound centred box (overflow hidden; min-height 0; min-width 0; z-index 1) with overflow-x clip on the stage (never stack duplicate scene SVGs in the sticky stage). At scale 1 the whole silhouette fits inside that box (media max-width 85% and max-height 85%, width/height auto, aspect ratio preserved) so nothing clips below the fold at 0% or 100%; draw one unified motif and animate transform only on the inner graphic, never scale the box itself.
At 1440x900, before the last scene, place the motif box (width 60%, height 100%, overflow hidden) and the text column (width 40%, vertically centred) side by side in separate non-overlapping regions so the motif never bleeds behind text. Scene 1: motif left, text right; Scene 2: motif right, text left.
The last scene is a centred closing lockup, unlike the first: use a two-row grid or flex column of top 64% (minmax(0, 64%), overflow hidden) above bottom 36% (minmax(0, 36%)) at full width so the entire motif stays inside the top 64% box and never shares space with or covers the closing name centred in the bottom 36%.
At 390x844 and 360x640 the box is top 0 to 45% of the stage in every scene and text sits between 52% and 94%, with 24px gutters, centred in the last scene. Text and motif never overlap, nothing is clipped, nothing scrolls sideways; shrink the display size until the longest line fits.
ASSETS: film.mp4, poster.jpg. No stock, generated or placeholder media.

Keyboard: every link is reachable, has visible focus, and focusing it scrolls to the hold of its scene. A deep link lands on that hold. Reload and resize draw the state of the current position.
Failed media shows the poster or the drawn still with the text intact; waiting over 300ms shows the poster or a quiet role="status" line, never a blank screen.
